effect.name: Krita Hard Mix (Background)
effect.description: (The effect comes from the Krita) Mixes both Color Dodge and Burn blending modes. If the color of the upper layer is darker than 50%, the blending mode will be Burn, if not the blending mode will be Color Dodge.
effect.author: Foxioo
